title: Re-verify a cleared stop condition: the reviewer line and the brief-construction note
body:
Fixes #11251

A stop condition whose only enforcement is the stopped party's self-report is not
enforced. A dev that reasons past one produces an artifact indistinguishable from one
that honoured it: an on-scope diff, green gates, and prose asserting the check passed.
This PR lands the graded scope — the PM-side rule — as exactly two lines on the
references face. `SKILL.md` is not touched.

## What landed

**`references/review-checklist.md`** — one new checklist item, placed directly after the
falsification item (`dev 验证过 issue 的前提吗?`) so the two read as a pair: falsification
is good work, **and** a cleared stop condition is re-verified by the PM on `origin/main`,
never accepted from the dev's prose alone. Its verdict criterion is the reported evidence
surface (what was searched, what was found) plus the PM's own re-check; the incident is
compressed to the house one-line form.

**`references/dispatch-runbook.md`** — one brief-construction note in `## 派发词构造细则`,
directly after the three-partition clause it is a sibling of: a premise/stop-condition
check in a brief must ask the dev to report **evidence**, not a verdict — the PM
adjudicates the fork.

Out of scope by the grading, and deliberately not attempted here: the separately-reported
artifact as a hard gate, and forbidding a same-turn commit past a stop condition. Both
change the dispatch state machine and are recorded as inputs to the whole-text
restructuring round rather than decided piecemeal.

## How the two lines were paid for

Both files sit at their line-ratchet ceilings with **zero headroom**. Payment is in-place
content compression — no ceiling raise, no re-wrap as payment, and no dated ruling or
verbatim maintainer quote deleted.

| file | before | added | compressed | after / ceiling |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| `references/review-checklist.md` | 82 | +4 | −4 | **82 / 82** |
| `references/dispatch-runbook.md` | 243 | +2 | −2 | **243 / 243** |

What was compressed, and what was removed from each:

- `review-checklist.md` — the local-gate-union item drops its restated rationale, which
  the preceding pin-to-head item and the dev-side contract already carry (−2); the
  cross-the-boundary item drops its closing aphorism (−1); the scope-check item folds its
  changeset-route tail (−1). Every operative branch survives: the contract requirement,
  the `head.sha` comparison, both-directions rejection, the no-HEAD-quoted handling, and
  both repos' tests/docs-only routes.
- `dispatch-runbook.md` — the three-state recovery item folds its two parenthetical
  incident retellings into the house one-line form, per that file's own 行文纪律 (−1);
  the subagent fast-forward paragraph drops the redundant alternative spelling of the
  command it already gives (−1).

Provenance preservation was checked mechanically rather than asserted: both files carry an
identical date inventory before and after, and the runbook's bracketed-quote inventory is
byte-identical (same set, same count). The one bracketed span that leaves
`review-checklist.md` is the scare-quoted phrase `「本地全绿」` inside the compressed
sentence — not a ruling, not a maintainer quote.

## Verification

Gate families derived on the actual change set with
`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (2 paths, committed
2 / working tree 0 / untracked 0), re-derived after the final commit — same 8 families, no
new one. The union below was run **after** the final commit, at HEAD `562cb567`, exit codes
captured before any pipe:

- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` — the two verdict lines this PR is accountable for:
  - `✓ check-skill-line-ratchet: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/review-checklist.md is 82 lines (ceiling 82; headroom 0).`
  - `✓ check-skill-line-ratchet: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md is 243 lines (ceiling 243; headroom 0).`
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` — `✓ check-skill-id-lint: 19 file(s) clean (pattern /#[0-9]{3,}/g).`
- `pnpm check:doc-authoring` — `✓ doc authoring guard: 389 files clean — no bare metadata literals.`
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` — `✓ check:doc-formula-expressions: 22 record-scoped formula example(s) across 418 files / 1447 TS blocks judged clean by @objectstack/formula.` (needed its dependency closure built first)
- `pnpm check:pm-governed-merges` — `✓ check-governed-merges --self-test: 129 assertions`
- `pnpm check:required-contexts` and `node scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs` — `✓ check-required-contexts: 6 required context name(s) pinned across 2 workflow(s)`
- `pnpm check:skill-frame-sync` — `✓ check-skill-frame-sync: 4 copies of the decision frame are structurally isomorphic across 3 files`

Control-byte self-scan over both edited files: no match (escaped spellings only).

No changeset — this is instruction-surface text under `.claude/`, publishing nothing;
`skip-changeset` per this repo's convention.

## Governance

only**, and **no auto-merge** is or should be enabled on it.
